concept: Area between a curve and the y-axis
prompt: Find the area of the region bounded by $y=x^{2}$ ($x\ge0$), the $y$-axis and the line $y=4$.
The line $y=\dfrac{r}{h}x$, $0\le x\le h$, is rotated through $2\pi$ about the $x$-axis. Show that the volume of the solid formed is $\tfrac13\pi r^{2}h$, and name the solid.
markscheme:
$V=\pi\displaystyle\int_0^h\left(\frac rhx\right)^{2}dx$ **(M1)** $=\pi\dfrac{r^{2}}{h^{2}}\left[\dfrac{x^{3}}{3}\right]_0^h$ **(A1)** $=\tfrac13\pi r^{2}h$ **(A1)(AG)**

A right circular cone of base radius $r$ and height $h$ **(A1)**
